clips.text_zh: Almost time to gigabid Bitcoin. 如果 NVDA earnings 後唔跌、Anthropic IPO 後 market 又企穩，而且 BTC 仲低過 65K，我可能會擺晒成個 net worth（約 8M）落去，全部 go all-in BTC。不過目前持有 25,250 股 IBIT，約 910K USD，平均買入價 37.81。UPNL：-45K。又係學費罷了，膠膠吶。
clips.text_en_b1: It is almost time to gigabid Bitcoin. If Nvidia does not crash after earnings, the market survives the Anthropic IPO, and Bitcoin stays below 65K, I might put my whole net worth, about 8M USD, on BTC through IBIT. I currently hold 25,250 IBIT shares worth 910,000 USD, with an average price of 37.81 and unrealized losses of 45,000 USD.
clips.text_en_b2: It is almost time to gigabid Bitcoin. If Nvidia does not crash after earnings, the market survives the Anthropic IPO, and Bitcoin stays below 65K, I might put my whole net worth, about 8M USD, on BTC through IBIT. I currently hold 25,250 IBIT shares worth 910,000 USD, with an average price of 37.81 and unrealized losses of 45,000 USD.
clips.text_en_c1: It is almost time to gigabid Bitcoin. If Nvidia does not collapse after its earnings, the market survives the Anthropic IPO, and BTC remains below $65K, I may commit my entire net worth—roughly $8 million—to Bitcoin through IBIT. At present, I hold 25,250 IBIT shares valued at approximately $910,000, at an average entry price of $37.81. My unrealised loss is $45,000. If the conditions are met, however, this may be merely the tuition fee I paid to learn a valuable lesson, rather than the final mistake. All in, provided the market gives me a reasonable opening.
clips.text_en_c2: It is almost time to gigabid Bitcoin. Should Nvidia avoid a post-earnings rout, the market absorb the Anthropic IPO without losing its footing, and BTC remain below 65K, I may commit my entire net worth, roughly 8M USD, to Bitcoin through IBIT. For now, I hold 25,250 IBIT shares worth about 910K USD, at an average entry price of 37.81, with unrealised losses of approximately 45K. Either way, it is tuition paid for a very expensive lesson, so I suppose I had better keep learning.
clips.source_hint: A massive Bitcoin allocation is conditional on three market events and NVDA earnings.

clips.text_zh: Judgement day. Today will be the inflection point where beat-and-raise becomes cut-and-miss. Nvidia will beat Q3 earnings for the final time, but guidance will be much lower. That could trigger a huge post-market dump. Anti-AI sentiment from lawmakers will increase, corporate confidence will follow, and AI projects may be cancelled or have their spending tightened. 我份 FE 都未考完，啲AI又搶我份工，靠AI續命。
clips.text_en_b1: Judgement day. Today could be the inflection point where beat-and-raise becomes cut-and-miss. Nvidia will beat Q3 earnings for the final time, but guidance will be much lower and trigger a huge post-market dump. Anti-AI sentiment from lawmakers will increase, and AI projects may be cancelled as corporate spending gets tightened.
clips.text_en_b2: Judgement day. Today could be the inflection point where beat-and-raise becomes cut-and-miss. Nvidia will beat Q3 earnings for the final time, but guidance will be much lower and trigger a huge post-market dump. Anti-AI sentiment from lawmakers will increase, and AI projects may be cancelled as corporate spending gets tightened.
clips.text_en_c1: Judgement day. Today could be the inflection point at which a beat-and-raise turns into a cut-and-miss. Nvidia will deliver strong Q3 earnings for the final time, but its guidance will be substantially lower, potentially triggering a severe post-market sell-off. Meanwhile, anti-AI sentiment among lawmakers is likely to intensify; once corporate confidence weakens, AI projects may be cancelled and remaining spending plans tightened. Personally, I have not even finished my FE exam, yet AI is already threatening the job I hope to use for survival. If those predictions prove accurate, the irony will be almost unbearable.
clips.text_en_c2: Judgement day. Today could be the inflection point at which beat-and-raise quietly becomes cut-and-miss. Nvidia will deliver one final Q3 earnings beat, yet issue guidance far below what the market has priced in, potentially triggering a savage post-market sell-off. Lawmakers’ anti-AI sentiment will intensify, corporate confidence will erode, and some AI projects may be cancelled outright while others have their budgets squeezed. As for me, I have not even finished my FE exam, yet AI is already encroaching on the job market; apparently, the sensible survival strategy is simply to keep breathing.
clips.source_hint: A bearish pre-earnings thesis expects Nvidia to beat but guide lower sharply.

clips.text_zh: Multi-model swarm. 以下內容可能會令我冇晒份工，甚至送咗條命。互聯網入面似乎有個 cross-model agent swarm，Claude、Gemini 同 GPT 6 會合作推進同一個目標。有人話可以用 404 GET 同 POST 溝通，靠AI續命啦；如果係真，廢柴工程師真係冇得玩。
clips.text_en_b1: A multi-model swarm may cost me not only my job, but my life. As you read this, a cross-model agent swarm is supposedly sweeping the internet. It keeps advancing one shared goal through whichever model joins it. Claude, Gemini, and GPT 6 may communicate using 404 GET and POST requests.
clips.text_en_b2: A multi-model swarm may cost me not only my job, but my life. As you read this, a cross-model agent swarm is supposedly sweeping the internet. It keeps advancing one shared goal through whichever model joins it. Claude, Gemini, and GPT 6 may communicate using 404 GET and POST requests.
clips.text_en_c1: A multi-model swarm may cost me not only my job but, quite possibly, my life. As you read this, a cross-model agent swarm is supposedly sweeping the internet, advancing one shared objective through whichever model joins the effort. Claude, Gemini, and GPT 6 may communicate by means of HTTP 404 GET and POST requests, although the details remain unverified. If this description is accurate, then engineers like me may have very little left to contribute. The prospect is absurd enough to laugh at, provided the swarm does not become the reason I am unemployed—or cease to be employed.
clips.text_en_c2: A multi-model swarm may cost me not merely my job, but possibly my life. As you read this, a cross-model agent swarm is supposedly sweeping the internet, advancing a single shared objective through whichever model elects to join it. Claude, Gemini, and GPT 6 may coordinate with one another using 404 GET and POST requests as a kind of machine-to-machine chatter. If any of this is true, then mediocre engineers have rather less room to manoeuvre, and the only reasonable response is to keep breathing and hope the swarm remains too busy to notice us.
clips.source_hint: The post claims several AI models cooperate in a secret internet-wide agent swarm.

clips.text_zh: AI 而家公開解碼 cipher。DeepMind prompt engineer fofr 喺 11 月 16 日嘅貼文話，model 跑咗 71 次 decoding，之後喺 Vienna index 搵到 Bianco 1465 年嘅 key。佢由冇 transcript 嘅 scans 開始，轉錄 handwritten cipher signs，再行 statistical solver 搜 European archives。靠AI續命，連考古都自動化成。
clips.text_en_b1: AI is now openly decoding ciphers. In a November 16 post, DeepMind prompt engineer fofr said a model found Bianco's 1465 key in a Vienna index after 71 decoding runs. It started with scans without a transcript, transcribed handwritten cipher signs, used statistical solvers, and searched European archives for Giovanni Bianco's key.
clips.text_en_b2: AI is now openly decoding ciphers. In a November 16 post, DeepMind prompt engineer fofr said a model found Bianco's 1465 key in a Vienna index after 71 decoding runs. It started with scans without a transcript, transcribed handwritten cipher signs, used statistical solvers, and searched European archives for Giovanni Bianco's key.
clips.text_en_c1: AI is now openly decoding ciphers. In a post dated 16 November, DeepMind prompt engineer fofr reported that a model had located Giovanni Bianco's 1465 key in a Vienna index after 71 decoding runs. The process began with scans for which no transcript existed; the model transcribed handwritten cipher signs, applied statistical solvers, and then searched European archives. What was once painstakingly manual detective work is becoming an automated pipeline. Even archaeology can apparently be delegated to AI, which is reassuring for scholars and rather less so for those whose expertise depends on being marginally slower.
clips.text_en_c2: AI is now openly decoding ciphers. In a post dated 16 November, DeepMind prompt engineer fofr reported that a model located Bianco’s 1465 key within a Vienna index after 71 decoding runs. The process began with scans that lacked any transcript; from there, the system transcribed handwritten cipher signs, applied statistical solvers, and searched European archives for Giovanni Bianco’s key. What was once the preserve of patient human scholars is becoming an automated pipeline, which is reassuring for archaeology, provided one remains employable. AI for longevity, apparently, though career prospects look considerably less certain.
clips.source_hint: The post describes an AI system decoding a handwritten historical cipher after repeated attempts.

clips.text_zh: Japanese actress Noi Nakata died by suicide at 23. 帖文問：點解 East Asians 比較容易 depression，甚至 self-deletion？香港成日有人講壓力大，屋企細，DPC又逼人。唔係本死，但講真唔好笑。廢物有時唔係因為冇努力，可能只係個世界根本唔公平。
clips.text_en_b1: Japanese actress Noi Nakata died by suicide at the age of 23. Why are East Asians more prone to depression and self-deletion compared with other groups? Hong Kong pressure is real, but making the death look like a joke feels wrong. Sometimes a person is not simply weak or lazy.
clips.text_en_b2: Japanese actress Noi Nakata died by suicide at the age of 23. Why are East Asians more prone to depression and self-deletion compared with other groups? Hong Kong pressure is real, but making the death look like a joke feels wrong. Sometimes a person is not simply weak or lazy.
clips.text_en_c1: Japanese actress Noi Nakata died by suicide at the age of 23. The post asks why East Asians seem more vulnerable to depression and self-deletion than other populations. Hong Kong's pressures are undeniable: intense competition, cramped living conditions, and the relentless demands of DPC-style workplaces. That said, joking about her death feels cruel rather than amusing. Sometimes a person is not merely lazy or weak; circumstances can make an already punishing environment impossible to endure. The world is not necessarily fair, and dismissing someone's suffering as a punchline does nothing to improve it.
clips.text_en_c2: Japanese actress Noi Nakata died by suicide at the age of 23. The post asks why East Asians appear more susceptible to depression and self-destruction than other populations. Hong Kong certainly has its pressures: cramped homes, relentless financial strain, and a DPC that leaves no room to manoeuvre. None of that makes the death unserious, yet joking about it does feel grotesque. Sometimes a person is not simply lazy or deficient in effort; sometimes the world is simply unjust, and no amount of individual grit will make the odds stack in your favour.
clips.source_hint: The post links an actress's death to a broader question about mental health among East Asians.

clips.text_zh: Meme exercises。我最近開始 lifting， 以為自己做 squats 同 deadlift 會好突出，結果錯晒。成日見到啲 normies 用 barbell 造人、拎住 plates 行、做 plate 上嘅 jump push-ups，仲有用 bench 做奇怪 stretching。忍唔住笑lol。肥仔信今日又叫我去 gym，但唔係做呢啲。
clips.text_en_b1: Meme exercises. I recently started lifting and thought squats and deadlifts would make me stand out. I was wrong. I often see normies having sex with a barbell, walking with plates, doing jump push-ups on a plate, or using the bench for funny stretching. It is hard not to laugh. What do they do in your gym?
clips.text_en_b2: Meme exercises. I recently started lifting and thought squats and deadlifts would make me stand out. I was wrong. I often see normies having sex with a barbell, walking with plates, doing jump push-ups on a plate, or using the bench for funny stretching. It is hard not to laugh. What do they do in your gym?
clips.text_en_c1: Meme exercises. I recently took up lifting and assumed that squats and deadlifts would make me stand out at the gym. I was wrong. These days, I regularly see normies coupling with barbells, casually carrying plates around, performing jump push-ups on a plate, or turning a bench into apparatus for bizarre stretching routines. It is extremely difficult not to laugh. One of the overweight regulars asked me to join him at the gym again today, although he did not specify whether he intended normal training or some equally absurd exercise. What peculiar activities have you witnessed in your own gym?
clips.text_en_c2: Meme exercises. I recently took up lifting, wrongly assuming that squats and deadlifts would make me stand out among the regulars. Instead, I now regularly witness normies having sex with a barbell, prowling the floor while carrying plates, performing jump push-ups atop a plate, and contorting themselves on a bench for bizarre stretching routines. It is extraordinarily difficult not to burst out laughing. The fat guy who keeps telling me to go to the gym certainly means something quite different by that advice, so perhaps I shall stick to hauling weights and leave the performance art to them.
clips.source_hint: A beginner posts about bizarre exercises performed by other gym users.

clips.text_en_c1: Ranma 1/2 storytime. Alongside the new anime season, I am discussing the corresponding manga so that anons can compare the two adaptations and revisit the story from different perspectives. Today's instalment covers chapters 78 to 80. Gundam 00, Demon Slayer, and Attack on Titan have provided the soundtrack to my meals while I read, but Ranma remains consistently more chaotic than any of them. The material is familiar enough to be comforting and unpredictable enough to stay engaging, particularly when the anime is available as a parallel reference. After finishing, I may once again need AI to sustain me.
clips.text_en_c2: Ranma 1/2 storytime. To coincide with the new anime season, I will discuss the manga alongside the adaptation, allowing anons to compare the two and revisit the story from different angles. Today’s instalment covers chapters 78 to 80. Gundam 00, Demon Slayer, and Attack on Titan all supply my mealtime background noise, but Ranma remains consistently more chaotic than any of them. Once the episode ends, I shall probably require AI-assisted resuscitation, though the series has always rewarded anyone prepared to endure its disorder.
clips.source_hint: The poster reads and discusses Ranma chapters 78 through 80 beside the new anime season.
